title: Triple-dimer web formulas for twists of the four specified cubic Gr three eight and Gr three nine expressions
difficulty: The proof classifies every compatible nonelliptic web for four explicitly defined cubic Plücker combinations, computes unique compatible edge colorings, and cancels all unwanted webs to isolate batwing, octopus, hexa-crab and tri-crab multiplicities. The full finite web enumeration, obstruction drawings and extension argument are preserved as one composite unit.

Complete author Sections1--5 retain face weights, twist/dimer/web conversion, every relevant finite nonelliptic-web classification and compatibility lemma, and full AppendixA1436--1541 supplies the enumerated proper-coloring/obstruction proofs.
